channel.title: MyStat stable updates
channel.description: Stable releases for Apple Silicon on macOS 26.

item.title: MyStat 0.1.2
item.description:
MyStat 0.1.2 adds the running app version to the dropdown and signed updates using Sparkle.
- Check for updates manually from the gear or menu-bar menu. - Opt in to daily update checks; automatic checks start off. Downloads and installation require your choice. - Update feeds and downloads are verified with Ed25519 signatures. No telemetry or hardware profiles are sent. - Update installation supports a writable, user-owned Applications folder on macOS 26.
Published 0.1.1 has no updater: install this release manually once. Future compatible releases can use in-app updates. macOS 27 remains experimental, and in-app updates are limited to macOS 26. Builds remain ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized; use the documented macOS per-app approval flow when installing manually.
Validated on macOS 26 with native build/unit tests, real Sparkle signed update integration tests, and VM launch-at-login/preference checks. Physical GPU/thermal/power compatibility must be validated on real hardware.
Bundled Sparkle retains its upstream license. Substantial implementation, documentation, and test assistance: OpenAI Codex.
